components.title: Deduplicate orders
components.what: Remove exact duplicate rows from the orders table, keeping each order_id once.

components.title: Filter eligible orders
components.what: Keep only orders with status shipped or pending and order_date between April 1 and June 30, 2026 inclusive.

components.title: Compute tier revenues
components.what: Join orders to customers on customer_id, calculate revenue as units * unit_price for each eligible order, and sum revenue separately for Gold-tier and Silver-tier customers.

components.title: Calculate difference
components.what: Subtract Silver-tier revenue from Gold-tier revenue and round to the nearest cent.
